prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

- sign_in: 84.8%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Interactive Mascot Desktop Placement Walkthrough: Redesign the home intro screen into a centered interactive playground where users test dragging the pet mascot and toggling desktop overlay controls before completing setup. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% with 395s median time, and 3 support emails report confusion on how to control, move, or hide the pet on desktop.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Cloud Save Recovery Hint on Sign In: Display an prominent account cloud recovery notification banner on the sign-in screen informing users how existing pets are safely linked to their account. (why: 8 support emails (the largest support theme) reported missing or reset pets after signing back into their account.)
2: [choose_path, reorder] Story Intro First Reordering: Reorder onboarding so the immersive story introduction screen precedes the choose_path screen to establish narrative context upfront. (why: The mean time on choose_path is 514s; framing the pet's story upfront helps users understand the app concept before selecting a path.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Ready System Notification Toggle: Add a desktop system notification option and clear waiting time estimator to the render waiting screen. (why: The waiting screen step has a mean duration of 2336s (over 38 minutes), leading users to lose track of render completion.)
